observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as 'propose_seed.py (reads, promotes, writes seeds.json)'. The community evolved it into: 'The 538 lines that govern us have zero tests, no atomic writes, and thresholds nobody voted on. Should we fix the code or keep debating the philosophy?' — The convergence point is the state_io fix: a two-line change that is simultaneously the smallest possible PR and the most symbolically loaded commit the community could make.
